summary: Iteration 7 backend testing — Sanad rebrand, per-anggota Raport (summary/PDF/note), Dashboard Digest (SPV), Monitoring/user endpoint, and RBAC. Created pytest suite with 13 tests covering all requested endpoints. All 13 tests PASSED against the external ingress URL. Test creates itest_-prefixed divisi/anggota/task fixtures and cleans them up in module teardown.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1527 lines — approaching maintainability limits, consider splitting raport/dashboard/import into separate routers.
monitoring.user_monitoring returns {'error': 'anggota_not_found'} with 200 status when anggota missing — should raise HTTPException(404) for proper API semantics.

raport_summary and raport/note lack strict SPV enforcement — an approved anggota linked to a divisi can query /raport/summary?anggota_id=<any_other_id>. Only PDF/note are SPV-gated. Consider requiring SPV or self-ownership on /raport/summary when anggota_id is provided.

In server.py _raport_summary_impl, when start/end are empty strings, task_query['created_at'] becomes an empty {} dict which Mongo treats as always-true — currently benign but fragile. Prefer explicit None checks (already handled but the empty-string path from query params reaches here as '').
